title: Say Armada ya Inabet na Flying Clay
intro: Nen panaon antis nen Propeta Muhammad, sakey a makapanyarin manuley a nanlapud Yemen so angigapo na kampanya militar ya say getma to et maneral ed sakey a sagradon santuaryo ed Makkah. Sayan kalaban so angidaulo na baleg ya armada a walaan na saray elepante ed bakal, a matalek ed biskeg tan bilang da. Balet, say biahe ra et biglan anampot ta walay ag-iilaloan ya impibiang na Dios. Naamtaan mo kasi no siopa ray akaarap ed sayan makatantandan panagkuenta?
clues: Nanmartsa kamin kaiba so baleg ya armada tan saray mabiskeg ya elepante ed guerra ya amaarap ed sagradon abung
Ginagala min buyaken tan deralen so sakey a pasen a panagdayewan ya impaalagey na saray lingkor na Sankamapangasi
Sakey a pulok na angkekelag a manok so imbaki sumpad sikami, ya awit da ray bato a pitek ed sangi tan kuko ra
Inabet kami na sakey a tanol ya angibantak na bato ed sikami, ya nagmaliw kamin ataktak iran nakdaan
Nanlapu ak ed dalin na Yemen tan nanlingkor ak ed silong na sakey a manuley ya manaanap na sagradon santuaryo
Nagmaliw kamin ehemplo na saramay malabay ya mamaandi ed santuaryo nen Allah

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say pangubkob ed sakey a kuta ed desierto
Say inlusob ed sagradon santuaryo ed Makkah
Sakey a panagrebelde sumpad sakey a managpairap ya ari
Say pananap ed abalang a propeta
trial.answer: Say inlusob ed sagradon santuaryo ed Makkah

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say lawak na Mina ya asingger ed Makkah
Say palasyo na Sana'a ed Yemen
Say kadaanan a syudad na Jerusalem
location.answer: Say lawak na Mina ya asingger ed Makkah

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Pananalo tan inkaderal na sagradon abung
Say inkatalo na saray manok ya mangaawit na saray bato ya pitek
outcome.answer: Say inkatalo na saray manok ya mangaawit na saray bato ya pitek

verse: Did He not make their plan into misguidance? (105:2-4)
